cell.label: For all: aspirin, oxygen, NTG, consider morphine.
Monitoring only; individualized treatment unless patient develops intermediate- or high-risk criteria.
NTG- Beta blockers. Consider: Clopidogrel, Heparin (UFH or LMWH), Glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitor.
NTG- Beta blockers, Heparin (UFH or LMWH), Glycoprotein IIb/IIIa if PCI planned or if abnormal ECG or elevated troponin Consider: Clopidogrel if no CABG; PCI if early invasive strategy.

Early conservative strategy for high risk: Use clopidogrel, Consider glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitor. Cardiac catheterization indicated if: Refractory ischemic chest pain, Recurrent/persistent ST deviation, Ventricular tachycardia, Hemodynamic instability, Signs of pump failure.

Early invasive strategy for high risk: To catheterization lab to define anatomy and perform PCI if indicated, Glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitor should be used, Clopidogrel can be safely used if PCI but not CABG.
